speaker: Ms See Jinli Jean
text: asked the Minister for Education (a) whether the Ministry requires all secondary school educators to be familiarised with the academic and practice pathways to benchmark and emerging careers under the future economic clusters; and (b) if not, whether the Ministry will consider doing so.

speaker: Ms See Jinli Jean (Nominated Member)
text: And given that there has been quite a fair bit of discussions on new careers, such as in AI, how are we working together with the teachers to keep them abreast of these developments so that they can then support the students in selecting careers for the future?

speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
text: There are various ways that our teachers gather information regarding future economy and the jobs and skills that are in demand.

speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
text: More than that, we do encourage our students themselves to be empowered and do their own searches online.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: The Clerk will now proceed to read the Order of the Day.

speaker: Mr Speaker
